_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your values
_quota_comment: Enable low_quota_mode to reduce Apps Script UrlFetch calls. Official Apps Script URL Fetch quotas are commonly 20,000/day for consumer accounts and 100,000/day for Google Workspace accounts; this mode helps stretch that budget by blocking tracker domains, dropping selected YouTube telemetry locally, disabling parallel range fanout by default, and allowing short caching of HTML/JSON/static responses.
_allowed_hosts_comment: Optional allowlist. When set, ONLY these domains (and subdomains) are reachable via proxy. Good for YouTube-only use.
_hosts_comment: Optional SNI-rewrite overrides. YouTube, googlevideo, gstatic, fonts.googleapis.com, ytimg, ggpht, doubleclick, etc. are ALREADY handled automatically (routed via google_ip with SNI=front_domain, same trick as the Xray MITM-DomainFronting config). Add entries here only for custom domains, e.g. "example.com": "216.239.38.120".
_sni_rewrite_suffixes_comment: Optional override for built-in SNI rewrite suffixes. Use this to keep rewrite only for domains that reduce quota without causing stale/restricted behavior.
